scope: The twelve workload/backend shards use different runners. Every ratio is the median of three paired-role samples from one shard; frames, percentiles and timings are never pooled across shards.
This is the d0 snapshot. Later production fixes and probe-only commits are not qualified by this historical matrix.
The active default candidate WebGPU transport is persistent RGBA. Opt-in composite and Graphite measurements are separate experiments and cannot replace these default-path observations.

WebGPU selection and hover remain slower in elapsed workload time despite much lower active renderer-thread CPU. The complete successful correctness matrix is not a claim that every workload became faster.
TaskDuration is elapsed renderer task time and may include waits. ThreadTime is active renderer main-thread CPU; it excludes GPU and worker CPU.

Offered operations per second, graphics-active callbacks and visible-canvas submissions are not physical displayed frames or input-to-new-pixels latency. Idle throughput is undefined and remains null.

The historical Uno 6 reference is measured only through Skia/WebGL. Most of its pan/zoom difference was already present in the Uno 7 regression baseline; it must not be attributed wholly to this change.

The native pixel boundary compares the Uno 7 baseline with the candidate at DPR1 in all before/after/restored states. Reference pixels and the separate high-DPI/extended-SVG matrices are outside this artifact's quality claim.
SwiftShader software graphics only; no hardware GPU throughput claim. All raw per-trial reports and PNGs remain bound by their original shard artifact digests.
